title: OPICA follow-up: combined proof checkpoint and agent handover
body:
The OPICA follow-up to #293 now contains the combined implementation, supplied Pro repair delivery, independent Codex review and a repository-native handover. A coding agent can continue from this branch without reapplying old overlays. This remains an incomplete draft: **all 100 original primary roots and 28 acceptance units remain required**.

Current publication: `9ccea78eb5ee0c097bde05424e43de58a589b713`, tree `40ad2bb6e78f9dcd944870233e991220f573a412`. The mathematical source checkpoint remains `a77ae60427423e8b6f098596f300c8cecc6392b6` (tree `b1ebc2edbe0c07a486fcb5cae8df742c9e4745ed`); the later revision changes documentation and its bounded integrity checks. It extends `9b6a9a3a2badb4cff62a56c1158d9cef8759d30d`, descending from accepted PR293 merge `d53dd70d38b0762af130b1d19b795af259f505f5`.

### Mathematical state

- **41 roots:** historical exact-source cold subset evidence, bound to the earlier checkpoint.
- **6 additional roots:** current narrow local module, independent full-type/domain consumer and standard-axiom checks passed. These are the two masked-rate roots, faithful complex-measure embedding, and three auxiliary-completion roots.
- **5 candidates:** retained WIP for Laguerre tails, dilated comb, first-cell sign/cost and the Step 1–3 consumer; unaccepted, with known failures or unresolved dependencies.
- **48 original roots:** still lack complete candidate implementations.

The six new narrow results are **not aggregate 47-root acceptance**. Current aggregate export/registration, full child compiler-receipt linkage, all-100 implementation and full-release acceptance remain OPEN. Supporting lemmas do not replace original primary obligations.

### Included changes

The three repaired Lean modules and unchanged independent consumers are now in the repository, alongside the five clearly identified WIP modules. Both foundational PDFs, original Markdown/JSON specifications, Post-Green Amendment v1.1, supplied evidence, earlier Codex audits and exact provenance are preserved.

The parent projection wrapper rejects stale/empty statement, route-authority and malformed dependency metadata before projection. Its incomplete full-100 type table still fails closed. The subset builder explicitly builds both exporter prerequisites. The workflow adds a separate repaired-candidate lane, all child tests and the repaired parent contract tests; the full-release gate remains closed.

The versioned continuation artifact manifest binds the additional handover/input/evidence paths without changing frozen original statements or required scope. Full dependency/facade/registration/canonical reconciliation remains required. The CORE archive omitted its optional runtime and baseline Git pack; the current guide gives normal checkout instructions and distinguishes historical offline instructions.

### Validation and limitations

- Exact supplied source and consumer hashes independently replayed under pinned Lean 4.33.0-rc2. All three modules and three consumers exited 0; all 14 printed axiom closures contain only standard Lean axioms. Source linter warnings are retained.
- Complete current child suite: **149 tests passed in each of normal and optimized Python** after adding the exact documentation-path guard; the preceding proof-source checkpoint had 148.
- Repaired parent contract: 66 runnable tests passed per mode; the full 68-test native attempts retain two environment failures (Windows symlink privilege and unavailable historical Git object). Supplied successful Linux evidence is preserved separately; it is not presented as a reproduced local result.
- Preparation passed in both Python modes; release actually returned `FAIL_RELEASE_INCOMPLETE` in both.
- All 100 ledger contract objects equal the frozen original contracts. All staged file bytes match the reviewed working files; parent mathematical Lean source is unchanged.

The earlier diagnostic run 39706211959 was fully harvested: preparation, cold prerequisites and regression succeeded; the ordinary unpatched subset exporter and full readiness failed. Its cold artifact was independently revalidated against the exact earlier Git source. It does not test this new checkpoint. **Fresh exact-head workflow results remain pending and must be harvested separately; no green CI or merge readiness is claimed here.**

### Continue directly in the repository

Start with [the current guide](https://github.com/HMarcusWH/zeta-23-lean/blob/a77ae60427423e8b6f098596f300c8cecc6392b6/research/RHRC/integration/opica_followup/continuation/2026-10-22/README.md), root [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/HMarcusWH/zeta-23-lean/blob/a77ae60427423e8b6f098596f300c8cecc6392b6/AGENTS.md), the [100-root ledger](https://github.com/HMarcusWH/zeta-23-lean/blob/a77ae60427423e8b6f098596f300c8cecc6392b6/research/RHRC/integration/opica_followup/continuation/2026-10-22/ROOT_LEDGER_100.json) and [next-agent task](https://github.com/HMarcusWH/zeta-23-lean/blob/a77ae60427423e8b6f098596f300c8cecc6392b6/research/RHRC/integration/opica_followup/continuation/2026-10-22/NEXT_AGENT_PROMPT.md). The [remaining-work inventory](https://github.com/HMarcusWH/zeta-23-lean/blob/a77ae60427423e8b6f098596f300c8cecc6392b6/research/RHRC/integration/opica_followup/continuation/2026-10-22/REMAINING_WORK.md) lists the 48 absent proofs.

The completed local [Post-Green Research Pass](https://github.com/HMarcusWH/zeta-23-lean/blob/a77ae60427423e8b6f098596f300c8cecc6392b6/research/RHRC/integration/opica_followup/continuation/2026-10-22/POST_GREEN_RESEARCH.md) covers all nine required conclusions, workflow evidence, upstream/downstream implications, revived routes, labelled leads and falsification checks. Repeat the complete pass after meaningful green results and harvest every workflow before full acceptance.

The [bounded workflow review at the mathematical source checkpoint](https://github.com/HMarcusWH/zeta-23-lean/blob/9ccea78eb5ee0c097bde05424e43de58a589b713/research/RHRC/integration/opica_followup/continuation/2026-10-22/evidence/current-codex/documentation-review/CI_SNAPSHOT.md) enumerated 22 runs and 55 instantiated jobs through 13:47:25 UTC: ten successes, two failures, one skipped and 42 pending. Full readiness and parent extension rejected the incomplete child; current mathematical compiler jobs were still queued. This is historical evidence at `a77ae604`, not CI acceptance of the new documentation head.

### Current documentation and graph navigation

The [core README](https://github.com/HMarcusWH/zeta-23-lean/blob/9ccea78eb5ee0c097bde05424e43de58a589b713/README.md), RHRC entry point, execution plan, audit/authority/protocol headers and accepted-parent guide now route agents to the current branch and evidence. The [documentation index](https://github.com/HMarcusWH/zeta-23-lean/blob/9ccea78eb5ee0c097bde05424e43de58a589b713/research/RHRC/integration/opica_followup/continuation/2026-10-22/DOCUMENTATION_INDEX.md), [module status table](https://github.com/HMarcusWH/zeta-23-lean/blob/9ccea78eb5ee0c097bde05424e43de58a589b713/research/RHRC/integration/opica_followup/continuation/2026-10-22/MODULE_STATUS.md) and [manual progress graph](https://github.com/HMarcusWH/zeta-23-lean/blob/9ccea78eb5ee0c097bde05424e43de58a589b713/research/RHRC/graph/OPICA_FOLLOWUP_CURRENT_STATE.md) locate all original roots and unfinished proof lanes.

All 143 newly introduced local links resolve, all 14 generated control blocks remain unchanged, the module table regenerates deterministically, and preparation passes while full readiness still fails closed. Seven additional documentation paths are individually hash-pinned; arbitrary source/registry exceptions remain rejected. Frozen specifications, mathematical Lean source and canonical generated graph products are unchanged. The preparation workflow now checks the ledger-derived navigation table. Fresh CI at the new documentation head remains pending.

**RH, Step 4 and the independent closing inequalities remain OPEN.** The amendment remains supporting research; no optional proposal has been promoted to a mandatory root.
